source.quote: 1-202. Executive Order No. 12076, as amended, is hereby

operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
By the authority vested in me as President of the United States of America  
by Section 5317 of Title 5 of the United States Code, and in order to place  
the position of Counselor on Labor Management Relations, Department of  
Commerce, in level IV of the Executive Schedule, Executive Order No. 12076,  
as amended, is further amended by deleting “Assistant to the Secretary and  
Land Utilization Adviser, Department of the Interior.” from Section l-102(g)  
and inserting “(s) Counselor on Labor Management Relations, Department of  
Commerce.” in alphabetical order in Section 1-101 thereof.

seeded_payload.research_rationale: EO 12111 (Jan. 2, 1979; 44 FR 1071) has a single operative provision: it amends EO 12076 (Levels IV and V of the Executive Schedule) to place the position of Counselor on Labor Management Relations, Department of Commerce in level IV, by deleting or inserting entries in secs. 1-101/1-102 of EO 12076. It has no effect of its own apart from the text it put into EO 12076. The 1989 Codification shows EO 12076 amended only by EOs 12099, 12111 and 12119 and revoked by EO 12154, so no other order altered these entries before the revocation. EO 12154 sec. 1-202 (Sept. 4, 1979) revoked 'Executive Order No. 12076, as amended', ending the amendment on that date; EO 12154 states no other effective date. EO 12154 sec. 1-1 re-lists only twelve other positions and does not carry this position forward. The OFR catalog note on this order reads 'Revoked by: EO 12154, September 4, 1979'. EO 12076 is claimed by another agent and is not claimed here. No human certification is asserted.

savings_residuals.reason: EO 12154 has no savings clause for EO 12076 or its amendments. Its only protective provision, sec. 1-201, keeps in office the occupants of the positions listed in its own sec. 1-1, and the position placed by this order is not among them; pay already received at level IV is a completed transaction, not a continuing effect. Bounded search: this order, EO 12154 in full, and the 1989 Codification row for EO 12076 (amended only by EOs 12099, 12111, 12119; revoked by EO 12154).
